about.title: About me
content: I am a full-stack software developer specializing in scalable backend systems, system architecture, and end-to-end product development.
Currently at Driven AVS, I develop B2B sim-racing applications and telemetry-based solutions, contributing to backend development, technical planning, and production delivery.

Previously at Pixa Software, I built e-commerce integrations for more than 50 marketplaces using Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, GraphQL, SQL, and REST APIs. My experience also includes high-volume telemetry processing, cloud infrastructure, web and mobile applications, and internal tools that solve operational business challenges.

items.title: RaceData.ai
items.description: RaceData.ai is a telemetry-driven performance analytics platform for Assetto Corsa, Assetto Corsa Competizione, and iRacing. It processes racing data to help drivers analyze braking behavior, acceleration, steering inputs, racing lines, lap consistency, and performance differences. The platform enables users to compare laps and turn raw telemetry into actionable insights through a scalable production infrastructure.
items.services: Full-Stack Development, Technical Leadership, Telemetry Processing, Cloud Infrastructure

features.title: Telemetry Collection
features.description: Collects detailed telemetry data from Assetto Corsa, Assetto Corsa Competizione, and iRacing for processing and performance analysis.

features.title: Performance Analysis
features.description: Analyzes braking, acceleration, steering behavior, racing lines, lap consistency, and performance differences to identify improvement opportunities.

features.title: Lap Comparison
features.description: Enables drivers to compare laps and performance data with other racers through data-rich visualizations and analytics workflows.

features.title: Scalable Infrastructure
features.description: Uses Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Redis, Bull Queue, Nginx, AWS EC2, and AWS S3 to process asynchronous workloads, manage traffic spikes, and store telemetry data reliably.

items.summary: RaceData.ai transforms high-volume racing telemetry into practical performance insights and supports more than 10,000 active users, 10,000+ recorded laps, and 1,000+ daily race sessions.
